_source: MACE foundation models (mace-torch >= 0.3.16). MACE-OFF: neutral organic molecules (SPICE, wB97M-D3BJ). MACE-MP-0: inorganic / materials (MPtrj, PBE+U). MACE-OMOL: the OMol25 model (wB97M-V, 83 elements, CHARGED + open-shell) via mace_omol(). MACE-MH-1: multi-head (OMAT/OMol/OC20/MATPES) via mace_mp(model='mh-1'). The label is stored on the calc; parse_mace_model() maps it to (loader, model-arg). OMOL/MH models read the calc's charge + multiplicity (MACE total_spin = the spin multiplicity 2S+1, i.e. the multiplicity itself; default 1 = singlet); MACE-OFF/MP ignore them.

MACE-OFF (organic)._note: Neutral organic molecules; loaded via mace_off(model=...).

MACE-MP-0 (materials)._note: Inorganic / periodic systems; loaded via mace_mp(model=...).

MACE-OMOL / MH (OMol25)._note: OMol25-trained. MACE-OMOL = the dedicated OMol25 model (mace_omol, extra-large, ASL license); MACE-MH-1 = multi-head incl. OMol (mace_mp, mh-1). Both use charge + multiplicity — set them on the card for ions / radicals.
